goal: Let callers choose the slug separator.

tasks.title: Slug separator option
tasks.description: slug takes an optional second argument { separator }. Options are checked by a new slugOptions helper in src/options.mjs: the separator defaults to "-" and must be one of "-", "_", "."; anything else throws a TypeError. slug(s) with no options behaves exactly as today.
scenarios: Given "Hello, World!" When slug is called with { separator: "_" } Then it returns "hello_world"
Given " Hello, World! " When slug is called with no options Then it returns "hello-world"
Given "a.b c" When slug is called with { separator: "." } Then it returns "a.b.c"
Given the separator "/" When slug is called Then it throws a TypeError
Given no argument When slugOptions is called Then it returns { separator: "-" }
